headline: Burned Hundreds of Billions in Six Years! Evergrande Automobile Officially Gives Up on Car Manufacturing; The Fate of 32.7 Billion in Debt Is Heartbreaking
summary: Evergrande Automobile has officially abandoned car manufacturing after burning hundreds of billions over six years. The fate of its 32.7 billion in debt is unclear.
why: Evergrande Automobile is the electric-vehicle unit of the Evergrande Group, a heavily indebted Chinese property developer. Its troubles are closely watched as a gauge of China's distressed property and auto sectors.
